note: Core product, then ecosystem integration, then pilot hardening, then production readiness.

name: Market Research & Pilot Study
note: Front-loaded cheaply, weighted to the pilot quarters, and heaviest in Q4 when willingness-to-pay has to be tested.

name: IP Filing & Management
note: Check DPIIT facilitator benefits and statutory fee schedules before committing this line.

name: Incubation & Mentorship
note: Flat across the year - the only line that does not flex.

note: Starts in Q2, once there is a product to register.

note: Late-year, and travel only where explicitly eligible.

name: Essential Contingency
note: A controlled reserve for essential unforeseen MVP/pilot requirements, subject to approval and funding rules. Not 'extra money'.
